ValidationRule.description: Integration job status changes must follow the documented lifecycle.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Queued"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Processing"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Processing"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Failed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Retry Scheduled"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Dead Letter"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Retry Scheduled"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Queued"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Dead Letter"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Failed"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Queued"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Dead Letter"))))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Integration job status cannot make that transition.
